title: Apparel Designer
description:
Job Title: Apparel Designer

Permanent Remote | Part-time


Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. If you thrive in both concept development and technical garment execution, this is the opportunity for you.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing
  • Select fabrics, trims, and color palettes that bring each collection to life while ensuring comfort, softness, and safety for babies
  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D



Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.

title: Apparel Designer
description:
Job Title: Apparel Designer

Permanent Remote | Part-time


Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. If you thrive in both concept development and technical garment execution, this is the opportunity for you.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing
  • Select fabrics, trims, and color palettes that bring each collection to life while ensuring comfort, softness, and safety for babies
  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D



Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer.

Innovecs is a global digital services company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Collaboration Tech, and Gaming.


For the fifth year in a row, Innovecs is included in the Inc. 5000, the list of fastest-growing private companies in the US, and a ranking of the best global outsourcing service providers by IAOP. Recently, Innovecs was honored with the prestigious Global Good Awards for the Employee Engagement & Wellbeing, won gold at the Employer Brand Management Awards, and was included in the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces Ranking.



Our value to you:

  • Flexible hours and remote-first mode,
  • Competitive compensation,
  • Complete Hardware/Software setup – anything you need for work,
  • Open-door culture, transparent communication, and top management at a handshake distance,
  • Health insurance, vacation, sick leaves, holidays, paid maternity/paternity leave,
  • Access to our learning & development center: workshops, webinars, training platform, and edutainment events,
  • Virtual team buildings and social activities.


Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps roles with deep, hands-on experience across both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS),
  • Expertise in CI/CD pipeline development and automation using GitLab Ultimate,
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS & EKS),
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), primarily using Terraform,
  • Experience in monitoring, performance optimization, and system security,
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Advanced Cloud Security: Experience with cloud-native security tools, identity management, and implementing security best practices,
  • MLOps Experience: Exposure to building or managing infrastructure for machine learning pipelines (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, MLFlow, KubeFlow).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS,
  • Develop and automate CI/CD pipelines for application deployment using GitLab Ultimate,
  • Manage and optimize containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS),
  • Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code, primarily using Terraform,
  • Monitor system performance, ensure high availability, and proactively address issues,
  • Apply cloud security best practices, including identity management and threat detection,
  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new tools and technologies to improve DevOps processes.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Especialista em Parcerias Estratégicas
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Especialista em Parcerias para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Identificar, mapear e prospectar organizações estratégicas (empresas de grande porte, associações e sindicatos).
  • Estruturar e negociar parcerias comerciais com potencial de gerar grande volume de usuários ou receita recorrente.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com BPOs que atendem empresas de grande porte para viabilizar contratos de alto impacto.
  • Representar a Jusfy em eventos estratégicos do setor jurídico, contábil e corporativo.
  • Acompanhar performance das parcerias e propor planos de expansão.


Experiência

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas, negócios corporativos ou vendas complexas (preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia).
  • Vivência em ambiente de crescimento e ritmo acelerado.
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais a clientes/parceiros.


Diferencial

  • Experiência ou conhecimentos sobre o mercado jurídico.


Habilidades

  • Capacidade de negociação em alto nível e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de representação em eventos externos.


Ferramentas e dados

  • Experiência com CRM (preferencialmente Hubspot)


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade, ownership e foco em solução de problemas
  • Curiosidade e sede por aprendizado contínuo
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados e crescimento


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Partnership Specialist e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Infra/Deploy)
description:
About the Project

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role:

As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Solutions team spans the globe and uses the SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing.

Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. We are employing best-in-breed tools along with processes co-authored or directly influenced by our team. We believe in the power of great customer experience, and the happiest customers are made by having the happiest team helping them.


Work Hours : PST business hours.


Required skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience supporting a software platform/product in a customer-facing B2B environment.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems (Debian and RHEL-based), including package management, service management, log analysis, file permissions, user and process management, and troubleshooting system resources (CPU, memory, disk, I/O).
  • Basic networking knowledge, including OSI,DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, subnets, routing, and firewall concepts, with ability to troubleshoot using tools like ping, traceroute, curl, or netstat.
  • Understanding of containerisation (images, containers, networking, volumes) and virtualisation (VMs, hypervisors) concepts, and familiarity with orchestration concepts such as deployments, scaling, and service discovery.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Python or scripting languages such as Bash is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs is an advantage.
  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is an advantage.


About you:

  • You have a data-driven, analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
  • You are detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • You demonstrate a proven ability to stay motivated and work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • You bring a proactive passion for supporting and helping others
  • You have a strong desire to learn, grow, and contribute to the company’s core values of collaboration and service
  • You possess excellent English communication, listening, and writing skills
  • You possess a strong sense towards customer sentiment and adapt your communication style accordingly
  • You are clear in setting expectations and meeting the promised timeline


Scope of work:

  • You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the UI and the terminal
  • You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow
  • You will partner with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Product to recognize trends in customer feedback and translate customer needs into a better overall product

  • Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems (Debian and RHEL-based), including package management, service management, log analysis, file permissions, user and process management, and troubleshooting system resources (CPU, memory, disk, I/O).
  • Basic networking knowledge, including OSI,DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, subnets, routing, and firewall concepts, with ability to troubleshoot using tools like ping, traceroute, curl, or netstat.
  • Understanding of containerisation (images, containers, networking, volumes) and virtualisation (VMs, hypervisors) concepts, and familiarity with orchestration concepts such as deployments, scaling, and service discovery.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Python or scripting languages such as Bash is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs is an advantage.
  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is an advantage.


About you:

  • You have a data-driven, analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
  • You are detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • You demonstrate a proven ability to stay motivated and work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • You bring a proactive passion for supporting and helping others
  • You have a strong desire to learn, grow, and contribute to the company’s core values of collaboration and service
  • You possess excellent English communication, listening, and writing skills
  • You possess a strong sense towards customer sentiment and adapt your communication style accordingly
  • You are clear in setting expectations and meeting the promised timeline


Scope of work:

  • You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the UI and the terminal
  • You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow
  • You will partner with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Product to recognize trends in customer feedback and translate customer needs into a better overall product

title: Amazon Account Manager
description:
Type: Full-Time Remote (must have video call on during the entire shift)

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST 


About Elumacom

Elumacom is a dynamic eCommerce business founded in 2016 and headquartered in Montreal, Canada. We sell on multiple online channels and partner with retail brands to expand their presence into eCommerce. Our team includes local office staff, a dedicated warehouse crew, and an expanding overseas support network. At Elumacom, we value a motivated, friendly, and respectful work environment where collaboration and positive interactions drive our success.


Role Overview

We are seeking a responsible, proactive, and energetic Amazon Account Manager to oversee and optimize our Amazon Seller Central operations. This remote position is open to overseas candidates, but you must be fluent in English (spoken and written) with strong communication skills.


Responsibilities

  • Manage daily Amazon Seller Central tasks: account emails, buyer messages, suppressed listings, tickets, and account health.
  • Track sales, returns, and profitability; prepare accurate weekly and monthly reports using advanced Excel formulas (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, etc.).
  • Monitor competitor pricing, Buy Box performance, PPC spend, and customer feedback.
  • Investigate issues independently, provide solutions, and take ownership until resolved.
  • Collaborate with local team members via full-time video presence during work hours .


Requirements

  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Proven experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.
  • Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, formulas, reporting).
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative abilities; willing to go the extra mile.
  • Highly responsible, able to take initiative and ownership.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and capable PC.
  • Positive, proactive, and team-oriented attitude.


Why Join Us?

At Elumacom, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to a growing company, and be part of a collaborative, international team. We are dedicated to supporting our employees with the tools, trust, and opportunities they need to succeed.



How to Apply: Send your resume and a brief cover letter to with the subject line Amazon Account Manager Application.

title: Photo Curation Expert
description:
About the Role:

Parlor Social Club is seeking a Photo Curation Expert to help us refine, organize, and elevate visual content from our events and social experiences. The ideal candidate has an eye for detail, strong creative judgment, and a passion for storytelling through photography.

Start: 5 hours per week , with the potential to grow to 10 hours/week  within two months

Rate: $8/hour

Remote-friendly


Responsibilities:

• Curate, organize, and select event and lifestyle photos for social media and marketing use.

• Maintain consistency in visual style and quality across platforms.

• Collaborate with our creative and events team remotely.

• Provide light editing or retouching guidance when necessary.


Requirements:

• Proven experience in photo selection, editing, or creative direction.

• Familiarity with content curation tools and image management systems.

• Strong sense of aesthetics and composition. Must have a portfolio

• Availability for part-time work

Perks:

• Remote-flexible work with a dynamic, creative global team.

• Opportunities to contribute to brand storytelling and event visuals.


To Apply:

  • Send your portfolio or a short sample of your curation work, plus a brief note about your experience

title: Brazil - Senior Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a highly skilled Senior Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll lead front-end development initiatives within a collaborative team environment, working directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers. Your expertise will guide the creation of intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. Ideal candidates will have a passion for innovation, staying ahead of emerging technologies, and mentoring team members.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with clients and lead team members through the design and implementation of high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Drive the adoption of modern development standards, tools, and frameworks to ensure the highest quality output.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Actively mentor junior and mid-level team members, promoting best practices and professional growth.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, maintaining productive relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 5+ years of professional front-end development experience
  • Deep proficiency with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Extensive experience with React, including complex state management and architecture.
  • Proficient with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Strong capabilities in browser testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • In-depth understanding of the entire web development process (design, development, and deployment)
  • Advanced understanding of UI/UX principles, design patterns, and responsive design.
  • Solid knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments


Nice to have

  • Professional experience with Next.js
  • Experience with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with various with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

title: Interface Designer / Web Developer
description:
Location: The role is fully remote. However, given our team’s current setup and time-zone alignment, we have a preference for candidates based in Europe, Latin America, or Mexico. 

Who We Are


COMO DL S.A., operating under the brand 'COMO Digital Life', is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg. As a SWIFT member, COMO DL offers SEPA and SWIFT payments and issues multi-currency LU IBANs.  


COMO Digital Life is revolutionizing corporate banking and treasury management with a next-generation, fully digitalized financial platform. Headquartered in Luxembourg COMO blends advanced cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and a user-first approach to set a new global standard in financial services. 


We believe great companies are built on clarity, care, and collaboration. If you’re ambitious, love creating new opportunities, and want to grow your career in a dynamic international environment, this is the place for you. 

Role Overview  


As a full-time remote Interface Designer / Web Developer at COMO, you will be responsible for building, deploying, and optimizing user-centric digital interfaces across COMO’s platforms. You will play a pivotal role in translating design concepts into functional, responsive, and accessible web experiences that embody COMO’s brand identity and meet the highest standards of usability and performance. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will ensure that all digital touchpoints are engaging, reliable, and aligned with the company’s vision. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Deployment & Implementation: Develop, configure, and maintain website pages on platforms such as WixStudio, Webflow, and MS Azure. Ensure seamless integration of pre-designed screens while optimizing for performance, security, and scalability. Guarantee cross-browser compatibility, consistent branding, and operational excellence across devices. 
  • User Experience Development: Design and refine intuitive user journeys that address client and partner needs. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business and user requirements into impactful digital solutions. 
  • User Interface Engineering: Transform design assets into interactive, user-friendly interfaces. Apply best practices in layout, typography, color, and accessibility to deliver interfaces that are both visually appealing and functional. 
  • Wireframing & Prototyping: Create and iterate on wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to test concepts, gather stakeholder feedback, and enhance usability before full-scale implementation. 
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews, testing, and debugging of deployed solutions. Ensure compliance with brand guidelines, technical specifications, and accessibility standards, delivering polished and reliable outcomes. 
  • Design System Integration: Contribute to the development and maintenance of COMO’s design system. Ensure components and patterns are consistently applied to achieve scalability and alignment across digital products. 
  • Responsive & Adaptive Design: Implement designs that adapt fluidly to various devices and screen sizes, ensuring seamless user experiences on desktop, tablet, and mobile. 
  • Accessibility Compliance: Apply WCAG and other accessibility standards to guarantee inclusive digital products. Perform accessibility audits and implement improvements as required. 
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work in partnership with designers, marketers, and developers to deliver projects on time and to the highest quality. Communicate technical approaches clearly, aligning design and development decisions with business goals. 
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation: Keep pace with evolving platforms, frameworks, and industry best practices. Experiment with new tools and methods to enhance COMO’s web platforms and bring forward innovative digital experiences. 


Qualifications

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

title: Coordenador(a) Pedagógico(a) – Bilíngue
description:
Responsável por liderar o planejamento e a execução pedagógica do programa bilíngue, acompanhando professores, alunos e famílias. Atuar garantindo a qualidade do ensino, o alinhamento curricular e o desenvolvimento integral dos alunos, com foco em resultados acadêmicos e formação docente contínua.


Responsabilidades principais:

  • Coordenar e acompanhar o planejamento pedagógico das turmas bilíngues.
  • Supervisionar o desenvolvimento acadêmico e socioemocional dos alunos.
  • Apoiar e formar professores, promovendo práticas pedagógicas consistentes e atualizadas.
  • Garantir a aplicação e o alinhamento do currículo bilíngue às diretrizes da escola.
  • Manter comunicação próxima e colaborativa com famílias e equipe gestora.
  • Acompanhamento do plano pedagógico junto aos professores.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Pedagogia, Letras ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação pedagógica.
  • Fluência em inglês (oral e escrita).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias bilíngues e práticas inovadoras de ensino.
  • Perfil de liderança, organização e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Power BI Developer, Remote mode in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Power BI, databricks, Azure, SQL

Python

Identify components in need of testing and prioritize the writing of those tests;

Work on POCs, small development/enhancement projects;

Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and client success staff to ensure the best-possible testing is achieved;

Understand business goals and requirements and take them into consideration when creating tests;

Improve our QA tooling and continuous testing within our CI/CD framework;

Collaborate within the Agile framework, foster a team approach to software development and delivery;

Create test plans and run them as needed;

Create and manage defect tickets for new and existing functionality;

Assist in release/deployment planning and execution activities;

Exercise independent judgement and discretion to define the issues and develop solutions to complex problems that require innovation and ingenuity;

Provide accurate level of effort time estimates and provide recommendations for feature prioritization;

Coordinate with internal teams to understand requirements and provide technical solutions;

Anticipate security issues, bugs, performance and scalability issues prior to them coming to pass;

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Professor(a) Ensino Fundamental - ANOS INICIAIS
description:
Resumo do cargo

O(a) professor(a) dos Anos Iniciais é responsável por conduzir o processo de ensino e aprendizagem de forma significativa, estimulando o desenvolvimento acadêmico e socioemocional dos alunos. Para o cargo, é essencial demonstrar experiência, domínio pedagógico e habilidade para criar experiências de aprendizagem e ser uma pessoa acolhedora.

Esse papel é central na organização, pois representa o elo direto entre a proposta pedagógica da Kingdom e a vivência diária dos estudantes, consolidando nossos pilares de excelência, formação integral e afeto.


Responsabilidades
  • Planejar e conduzir aulas alinhadas à proposta pedagógica da escola, promovendo o desenvolvimento integral dos alunos.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos estudantes por meio de observações, registros e instrumentos avaliativos diversificados.
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas, formações e projetos interdisciplinares.
  • Manter comunicação constante e positiva com famílias e equipe escolar.
  • Colaborar com a coordenação pedagógica no aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de ensino.
Qualificações
  • Graduação completa em Pedagogia (ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino fundamental – anos iniciais.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente colaborativo.
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Comprometimento com a formação integral e com os valores da Kingdom School.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Python/React
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A vaga é para uma empresa recém adquirida pelo iFood, eles possuem uma plataforma tecnológica voltada ao setor de food service, que digitaliza e automatiza toda a operação de restaurantes. Oferece módulos como cardápio digital, gestão de pedidos, delivery e relatórios analíticos. A solução é integrada, funciona mesmo offline e atende desde pequenos negócios até grandes redes.



Sobre o Papel

Como Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior - Python e React, você será responsável por:


Responsabilidades

  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de aplicações web de ponta utilizando as tecnologias Python e React;
  • Trabalhar em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção da aplicação até a sua implantação;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Produto e Design para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficientes;
  • Escrever código de alta qualidade, bem documentado e testado;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias constantes nos processos e na arquitetura da aplicação;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e dar suporte técnico à equipe, sempre buscando o crescimento coletivo.



Habilidades Necessárias

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e suas principais bibliotecas (Django, Flask, etc.);
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web com React.js;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL);
  • Habilidade em desenvolver APIs RESTful e trabalhar com arquiteturas orientadas a microserviços;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e metodologias ágeis;
  • Bom entendimento de conceitos de infraestrutura e implantação de aplicações (containerização, CI/CD, etc.);
  • Comunicação eficaz, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Backend Developer (NestJS & TypeScript)
description:
Sobre a YellowIpe


Temos a missão de inspirar a conexão da tecnologia com as pessoas, fomentamos o melhor de nossos profissionais através de nossa expertise em encontrar e atrair os melhores talentos para os melhores projetos.

O Foco nas Pessoas, Colaboração e Comprometimento são os pilares que nos guiam nessa trajetória.


Junte-se à equipa amarela como nosso novo Backend Developer (NestJS & TypeScript)!


Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações backend de alta performance, principalmente com NestJS e TypeScript
  • Aplicar consistentemente os princípios SOLID , Clean Code e Design Patterns para garantir um código limpo, manutenível e escalável
  • Desenhar e implementar soluções baseadas em arquitetura de eventos , utilizando tecnologias como GCP Pub/Sub para garantir a comunicação assíncrona e desacoplada entre serviços
  • Trabalhar ativamente com o ecossistema de nuvem GCP , incluindo serviços como Cloud Run , Cloud Storage (Buckets) , entre outros
  • Modelar e otimizar bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server ) e NoSQL (MongoDB )
  • Desenvolver e manter Stored Procedures em SQL Server para lógica de negócios complexa e otimização de performance
  • Utilizar Redis para caching e melhoria de performance das aplicações
  • Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares (Produto, QA, DevOps) para definir, projetar e entregar novas funcionalidades
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentor(a) para desenvolvedores(as) de níveis júnior e pleno
  • Realizar Code Reviews criteriosos para garantir a qualidade e a conformidade com os padrões de desenvolvimento
  • Manter e/ou dar suporte a sistemas legados ou componentes desenvolvidos em C# (nível básico/intermédio)


Requisitos:


  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior
  • Profundo conhecimento em NestJS e TypeScript
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID , Clean Code e principais Design Patterns
  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , incluindo Pub/Sub , Cloud Run e Cloud Storage
  • Excelente conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server ), incluindo criação e otimização de Stored Procedures
  • Experiência com bancos NoSQL , especialmente MongoDB
  • Experiência prática com Redis (caching)
  • Conhecimento básico em C# e no ecossistema .NET
  • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico
  • Excelentes capacidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento em outras plataformas de nuvem (AWS )
  • Experiência com ferramentas de containerização e orquestração (Docker , Kubernetes )
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento avançado em C#
  • Inglês desejável.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Short-term Project)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Mobile Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in mobile application development to work for our U.K. / U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in native or cross-platform framework development to make tech stack and architectural decisions, as well as build an initial MVP that will become a core tool powering the client's operations and data delivery.

The project must start by mid-November 2025 and will last 3 to 6 months.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Take complete ownership of the development of a mobile application that will become a core tool powering the client's operations and data delivery
  • Deliver a robust, performant MVP that supports offline usability, reliable data sync, and scalable architecture
  • Design and implement the complete lifecycle architecture, development, QA, and deployment in coordination with the Tech Lead
  • Collaborate with product and platform engineers to ensure consistency of data models and APIs
  • Guide the client's future mobile technology choices (native vs. hybrid), embedding best practices and maintainable patterns from the start


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in mobile application development for both iOS and Android
  • Deep expertise with native development (e.g., Swift, Kotlin, React Native) and proven experience delivering to production OR experience with cross-platform frameworks (e.g., React Native, Flutter), combined with comfort extending native features
  • Strong understanding of offline data handling, synchronization, and API-driven integration
  • Experience balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term scalability
  • Excellent communication and ability to self-manage in a distributed team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Web Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ English fluency is a must for this role ⚠️

⚠️A challenge will be required ⚠️


Who We Are


Hey there! We’re Uitify, a creative design studio delivering premium UI/UX and branding for early-stage SaaS startups in the US. We help founders turn vision into beautifully functional design. If you're all about detail, innovation, and creating modern digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.


What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for a Senior Web Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and build high-converting, visually stunning websites. You’ll own web projects from idea to execution, working closely with founders, marketers, and our internal design team. If you’re a Framer expert, know how to design for impact, and care about both beauty and usability—we want you.


What You’ll Do


  • Design and build standout websites using Framer (bonus: Webflow skills);
  • Collaborate with clients to understand goals and translate them into compelling web experiences;
  • Work closely with UX/UI and branding to ensure cohesion across touchpoints;
  • Build landing pages, homepages, product pages, and more;
  • Help evolve and maintain web design systems and components;
  • Optimize sites for responsiveness, performance, and accessibility;
  • Stay on top of design trends and share what you learn with the team.


What You’ll Bring


  • Strong English skills (you’ll be in calls with US clients);
  • 10+ years of experience in web design, especially for SaaS or tech;
  • Killer portfolio with websites that show your visual and technical chops;
  • Solid knowledge of Framer (must-have), Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop;
  • A passion for sleek, clean, and functional design;
  • Ability to manage your time and deadlines independently.
  • UX/UI background;
  • Motion design or video editing (even basic);
  • Experience working with developers or low-code tools like Webflow.


Salary & Benefits:


  • USD $2000 (based on experience)
  • Fully remote team — work from anywhere
  • Growth-focused culture with tons of learning opportunities
  • Impact-driven projects with startups solving real problems
  • Friendly, supportive, and transparent environment


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, your work directly impacts fast-moving startups. You’ll have freedom to explore ideas, contribute to strategy, and help shape the future of digital design—all from wherever you are.


How to Apply


If you’re a web designer with a passion for solving complex problems and SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

⚠️A challenge will be required ⚠️


Who We Are


Hey there! We’re Uitify, a creative design studio delivering premium UI/UX and branding for early-stage SaaS startups in the US. We help founders turn vision into beautifully functional design. If you're all about detail, innovation, and creating modern digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.


What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for a Senior Web Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and build high-converting, visually stunning websites. You’ll own web projects from idea to execution, working closely with founders, marketers, and our internal design team. If you’re a Framer expert, know how to design for impact, and care about both beauty and usability—we want you.


What You’ll Do


  • Design and build standout websites using Framer (bonus: Webflow skills);
  • Collaborate with clients to understand goals and translate them into compelling web experiences;
  • Work closely with UX/UI and branding to ensure cohesion across touchpoints;
  • Build landing pages, homepages, product pages, and more;
  • Help evolve and maintain web design systems and components;
  • Optimize sites for responsiveness, performance, and accessibility;
  • Stay on top of design trends and share what you learn with the team.


What You’ll Bring


  • Strong English skills (you’ll be in calls with US clients);
  • 10+ years of experience in web design, especially for SaaS or tech;
  • Killer portfolio with websites that show your visual and technical chops;
  • Solid knowledge of Framer (must-have), Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop;
  • A passion for sleek, clean, and functional design;
  • Ability to manage your time and deadlines independently.
  • UX/UI background;
  • Motion design or video editing (even basic);
  • Experience working with developers or low-code tools like Webflow.


Salary & Benefits:


  • USD $2000 (based on experience)
  • Fully remote team — work from anywhere
  • Growth-focused culture with tons of learning opportunities
  • Impact-driven projects with startups solving real problems
  • Friendly, supportive, and transparent environment


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, your work directly impacts fast-moving startups. You’ll have freedom to explore ideas, contribute to strategy, and help shape the future of digital design—all from wherever you are.


How to Apply


If you’re a web designer with a passion for solving complex problems and SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Who We Are:


AdMaxTech is a leading mobile app user acquisition agency, working directly with top-tier advertisers across various app verticals. Our team brings together expertise from global tech giants and world-class performance marketing agencies.


Why Join Us:

  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from your preferred location.
  • Be part of a fast-paced, results-driven environment in the booming mobile advertising industry.
  • The global mobile advertising market exceeded $280 billion in 2022 and is projected to reach $353 billion by 2025 — a 26% growth opportunity you can be part of.
  • Join a diverse, international team with a strong focus on collaboration, growth, and performance.


Your Role:

As a Business Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in expanding our advertiser partnerships and driving revenue growth. Your main responsibilities include:

✔ Research and identify the right decision-makers within potential advertiser organizations.

✔ Conduct pitch meetings and negotiations with prospective clients, aiming to close new deals.

✔ Collaborate closely with our internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new clients.

✔ Maintain up-to-date records and follow-up activities in our internal tracking system.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong research and communication skills.
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or account management, preferably in digital marketing, mobile apps, or ad-tech.
  • Self-driven, organized, and result-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.


Why It’s Exciting:

The mobile app industry is growing fast — so are we. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact, contribute to our success, and grow your career alongside experienced professionals.


*AdMaxTech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Product Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Senior experience: 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a senior product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role and Reponsabilities:

In this role you will have the chance to build large additions to our platform ecosystem, contributing to an infrastructure that centralizes our ETL and streaming infrastructure, enables experimentation and data development, and powers algorithm development. You will design and build scalable engineering solutions to solve business and data problems.


Core tech stack used by this role:

-S3 using Parquet and Iceberg for data storage

-Hive and Iceberg REST catalog as our metadata store

-Spark (Python, SQL, Scala) for data transformation

-Go, Scala and Java for backend development

-Kafka for data streaming

-Kubernetes and Helm for service deployments

-AWS IAM for access control

-Datadog for logging alerting and monitoring

-Trino as our federated query engine

-Identify, develop, and evangelize tooling, approaches, and data products that raise the bar of validity in experiment design and analyses across the company

-Collaborate with multiple teams and functions to deliver deep-dive analyses and experiment design for new initiatives and high-priority business areas

-Develop and iterate on our processes to empower more efficient and rigorous experimentation


Requirements

-You have a degree in an engineering or computer science field

-You have solid experience in platform engineering, with experience on experimentation platforms

-You have experience coding at a production level in Python, Go, Scala or Java

-You’ve built and supported RBAC systems used by enterprise-wide teams

-You have experience supporting Iceberg-based data warehouses



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.
